notes: glob::glob(root + "/" + pattern) once per pattern, default options; the iterator is collected into paths. Hidden names match * and **, so it is recorded as not passing.
details: MatchOptions { require_literal_leading_dot: true } makes * and ** skip hidden names, but it also hides them from a literal segment after **: **/.gitignore then finds nothing (glob 0.3.3 drops dot entries when it lists a directory for a wildcard). With those two patterns taken out of the check it passed the other patterns; no variant is entered because none can pass.
